newsitem.title: USA: ABN AMRO unit completes Chicago Corp buy.
newsitem.headline: ABN AMRO unit completes Chicago Corp buy.

text.p: ABN AMRO Holding NV said Thursday its ABN AMRO North America Inc division completed its previously announced purchase of ChiCorp Inc, the parent of Chicago Corp, for an undisclosed amount.
ABN AMRO will merge the investment bank with its securities unit to form ABN AMRO Chicago Corp. The combined firm is expected to have regulatory capital of $450 million.
The company said John Wing, chairman and chief executive officer of Chicago Corp, will serve in the same posts at the new combined investment bank.
ABN AMRO is the world's 14th largest bank.
